title: Pack implements BaseApp contract
description: Every Capability Pack must implement all abstract BaseApp methods.
expected_behavior: A pack extending BaseApp must implement all abstract methods (get_capabilities, execute, validate_input). Optional hooks (register_event_handlers, shutdown) have no-op defaults.

test_steps.expected: BaseApp is an ABC with abstract methods

test_steps.action: create a concrete subclass with all abstract methods implemented
create a subclass missing one abstract method
validate a real pack class via ContractValidator.validate_baseapp
test_steps.expected: ComplianceReport.passes is True for a valid pack
